description: This file defines the EmployeeDependentService class within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manage employee dependents, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and searching of dependents. It interacts with the EmployeeDependentDao for data access and handles exceptions specific to service operations.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentService
classes.description: Service class that manages employee dependents including retrieval, modification, deletion, and search functionalities, utilizing the EmployeeDependentDao and handling service-specific exceptions.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the EmployeeDependentDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: setEmployeeDependentDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeDependentDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Fetches all dependents for a specific employee identified by their employee number.

methods.name: getEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dependent record for an employee using employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: saveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee dependent record.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes dependents for an employee specified by employee number and list of entries to delete.

methods.name: searchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Performs a search for dependents based on filter parameters, throws ServiceException on error.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of dependents matching search parameters, throws ServiceException on error.
